# **Chapter 37. ISA Extension Naming Conventions**

This chapter describes the RISC-V ISA extension naming scheme that is used to concisely describe the set of instructions present in a hardware implementation, or the set of instructions used by an application binary interface (ABI).

_The RISC-V ISA is designed to support a wide variety of implementations with various experimental instruction-set extensions. We have found that an organized_  _naming scheme simplifies software tools and documentation._
